Saffron Lee: Hey team :wave: — Saffron here, first day! Running a little late because of a rogue umbrella and a puddle. Made it in now. Desk `B12`, coffee preference: oat latte. Happy to join the 11:30 lunch crew if that's a thing. Also badge hasn't activated yet.
Miki Tanaka: Welcome Saffron! :tada: I'll grab you a spare umbrella from the bin if you want. Oat latte noted. Lunch crew usually in #lunch-plans, but count me in.
People Ops: Welcome @Saffron Lee! We sent you an onboarding checklist. Badge activation queued, should be live in ~10 min. Ping here if still locked out.
Juno Park: Hi Saffron! I left a little plant on `B12` when I saw recent move-ins — hope you like succulents :seedling:
Ada Singh: If you want a desk swap, `B12` is sunny in the afternoon. Also there's a standing-desk knob under the right side.
Sam R.: Welcome! Coffee run in 10? I'm grabbing shots from the small machine. Oat latte for you. :coffee:
Facilities Bot: Badge activation completed for Saffron Lee — try swiping now. (bot)
Saffron Lee: Thanks everyone! Swiped in, works now. Thanks for the plant Juno :heart_eyes: See you at the coffee run.
Nora Kim: Quick poll: office playlist — lo-fi or 80s synth for today? React with :headphones: for lo-fi, :boom: for 80s. (jk, both?)
